text:
Every chain starts in the ground.
Place a Clay Pit on clay.

A Brick Kiln bakes clay into bricks.
Place one near the pit.

Pick Belt, then drag from the pit to the
kiln, or tap one and then the other.

Kilns burn logs. Put a Lumber Camp on the
forest and belt it to the kiln.

Something stopped? Tap Trace, then the
building, to see why.

No belt yet? Tap a building to pick up
what it made, then tap another to drop it.

One pit can't keep a kiln busy. Add a
second and end its belt on the first.

A Splitter shares one belt between
two buildings. Belts out take turns.

Homes need planks too. A Sawmill makes
them from logs.

A Builder's Yard builds cottages from
bricks and planks.

Belt bricks and planks to the yard. It
starts a cottage once both keep coming.

Tap Rates to see how much each building
makes and uses a minute.

Far apart? Lay a Road and pick Truck:
tap where it loads, then where it goes.

Put something in the wrong place?
Undo is free.

Waiting on cottages? The speed button
makes time run faster.

A Storage Crate holds spare items and
passes them on when belted out.

Demolish takes a building down to make
room. Your chain, your rules.

Grey rock holds stone. A Quarry cuts it,
for wells and water towers.

A Waterwheel beside water powers up to 4
machines close by. Belt 12 planks into it.

A Water Pump next to the wheel lifts water.
It needs 8 bricks to finish.

Pick Pipe and drag from the pump. Pipes
run under roads and belts.

End the pipe at a Water Tower: homes
around it get water. Wells help nearby.

Food starts in a Wheat Field. It grows on
any land, but needs water like a home.

A Flour Mill grinds wheat. It needs a
Waterwheel within 6 tiles to turn.

A Bakery bakes flour into bread. It burns
logs and needs water.

A Market Stall holds bread for the town.
Belt or truck bread into it.

Fields tire and slow down. A Compost Heap
makes compost to bring them back.
